gaps.lead: My father repaired the roof himself.
gaps.explanation: have something done = arrange for it to be done by someone else: had the roof repaired.

gaps.lead: We couldn't go out because of the heavy rain.
It took me two hours to assemble the wardrobe.
gaps.sentence: I ___ two hours assembling the wardrobe.
gaps.explanation: it took + time + to do = subject + spent + time + -ing.

gaps.lead: 'I've never been to Asia,' she told me.
gaps.sentence: She told me that ___ to Asia.
gaps.explanation: Present perfect shifts to past perfect: she had never been.

gaps.lead: People think she was the best singer of her generation.
gaps.sentence: She ___ the best singer of her generation.
gaps.explanation: A present belief about a past event uses is thought to have + participle.

gaps.lead: He apologised because he was late.
gaps.explanation: apologise FOR + -ing: apologised for being late.
